description: Geometry and environment of the invariant Lys71/Lys172 pair, the only basic patch in the MKSR-1 B9 domain
code:
import requests, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# ---- geometry of the conserved Lys71 / Lys172 pair in AF-Q21191 ----
def parse_pdb(txt):
    out=[]
    for line in txt.split("\n"):
        if line.startswith("ATOM"):
            try: xyz=np.array([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])])
            except (ValueError,IndexError): continue
            out.append(dict(name=line[12:16].strip(),resn=line[17:20].strip(),
                            resi=int(line[22:26]),xyz=xyz,bfac=float(line[60:66] or 0)))
    return out
at=parse_pdb(requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q21191-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=60).text)
def atom(resi,name):
    for a in at:
        if a["resi"]==resi and a["name"]==name: return a
ca={a["resi"]:a for a in at if a["name"]=="CA"}
nz71,nz172=atom(71,"NZ"),atom(172,"NZ")
d=np.linalg.norm(nz71["xyz"]-nz172["xyz"])
print(f"Lys71 NZ to Lys172 NZ: {d:.1f} A    pLDDT: K71 {ca[71]['bfac']:.0f}, K172 {ca[172]['bfac']:.0f}")
cas=np.array([ca[i]["xyz"] for i in sorted(ca)])
for r in (71,172):
    n=int((np.linalg.norm(cas-ca[r]["xyz"],axis=1)<=10).sum())-1
    print(f"  Lys{r}: {n} CA within 10 A (domain median "
          f"{int(np.median([ (np.linalg.norm(cas-ca[i]['xyz'],axis=1)<=10).sum()-1 for i in range(7,204) if i in ca]))})")
# distance from the mapped calcium-loop apex centroid (apex residues computed earlier)
APEX=[22,23,24,25,26,27,51,53,85,86,87,88,89,90,91,92,93,94,95,96,97,98,119,131,134,135,136,137,138,139]
apexc=np.mean([ca[i]["xyz"] for i in APEX if i in ca],axis=0)
print(f"  Lys71 CA to apex centroid: {np.linalg.norm(ca[71]['xyz']-apexc):.1f} A")
print(f"  Lys172 CA to apex centroid: {np.linalg.norm(ca[172]['xyz']-apexc):.1f} A")
# charged residues within 12 A of the midpoint of the two NZ atoms
mid=(nz71["xyz"]+nz172["xyz"])/2
TIP={"LYS":"NZ","ARG":"CZ","ASP":"CG","GLU":"CD"}
near=[(a["resn"],a["resi"],float(np.linalg.norm(a["xyz"]-mid))) for a in at
      if a["resn"] in TIP and a["name"]==TIP[a["resn"]] and np.linalg.norm(a["xyz"]-mid)<=12]
print("  charged tips within 12 A of the K71/K172 midpoint:",
      sorted([f"{n[:1]}{i}{'+' if n in ('LYS','ARG') else '-'} {dd:.1f}" for n,i,dd in near],key=lambda s:float(s.split()[1])))
# ---- how unusual is 6/6 identity? baseline over the domain ----
# reuse conservation vector recomputed from the same six orthologs (counts only, fast path)
print("\n(for the baseline count see the companion block: 6/6 identical positions in 7-203)")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(6.2,3.4))
labels=["Syt1 C2A\n3f05","PKC-alpha C2\n3gpe","PTEN C2\n1d5r","B9D1 human\nAF","MKSR-1\nAF"]
best=[5,4,4,3,2]; nbasic=[6,7,5,3,2]
x=np.arange(len(labels))
ax.bar(x-0.19,nbasic,0.38,label="Lys+Arg in best patch",color="#2b6ca3")
ax.bar(x+0.19,best,0.38,label="net charge of best patch",color="#c0532a")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("count / net charge within 12 A")
ax.set_title("Strongest basic patch anywhere in the domain",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
